lines.t: (Intro)
I spent a lifetime chasing shadows down the hall
Building up my kingdom just to watch the curtain fall
I was leaning on a broken reed, drifting in the grey
Counting every second just to throw the hours away
Yeah, I was drowning in the static, lost inside the noise
Trading my inheritance for temporary joys.
(Pre-Chorus)
The clock was ticking, but I wasn't moving
I had a debt that I was never proving
Then the light broke through the dark.
(Chorus)
I’m done wasting my time on the things that fade
I’m stepping out of the debt that You already paid
No more running in circles, no more living in the hollow
You’re the only path, You’re the only one I follow
I’m not wasting my time anymore
No, I’m not wasting my time anymore.
(Verse 2)
There’s a fire in the silence, a peace I can’t explain
You took the heavy burden and You washed away the stain
Now the minutes have a purpose, and the seconds have a soul
I gave You all the broken pieces, and You made them whole
I used to wake up heavy, now I’m breathing in the grace
I see the finish line, I’m finally in the race.
(Pre-Chorus)
The clock is ticking, and now I’m moving
I’ve got a love that I’m finally choosing
Yeah, the light broke through the dark.
(Chorus)
I’m done wasting my time on the things that fade
I’m stepping out of the debt that You already paid
No more running in circles, no more living in the hollow
You’re the only path, You’re the only one I follow
I’m not wasting my time anymore.
Every breath is a gift I don’t deserve
Every moment is a chance for me to serve
(Guitars explode back in)
Yeah, I’m wide awake!
I’m wide awake!
I’m done wasting my time on the things that fade
I’m stepping out of the debt that You already paid
No more running in circles, no more living in the hollow
You’re the only path, You’re the only one I follow
I’m not wasting my time anymore!
(Outro)
No more wasting it
No more chasing it
I’m found in You.
